content: {"conclusions":[{"claim":"The benchmark defines 672 synthetic cases across 14 families with fixed dev/held-out splits and six configurations.","evidence":"Implemented and tested → `scenarios.py` + committed `manifest.json`: 672 synthetic configured cases; 336 dev and 336 held-out; manifest SHA-256 `df1356777ddc82a22c0f429a2e9b1285bc675847831db8798184742f50ae1307`.","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the scenario manifest is sufficiently specified for a frozen benchmark and integration review.","caveat":"Round 3 source is uncommitted, so the coordinator must verify the files, manifest hash, split freezing, and oracle implementation before treating this as reproducible."},{"claim":"The reported local test suites passed.","evidence":"Implemented and tested → Validation table: `uv run pytest -q` = 341 passed in 43.55 s; `uv run pytest experiments/agent-bench/tests -q` = 38 passed in 0.48 s.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the benchmark harness is ready for integration and cloud-result interpretation.","caveat":"Passing tests establish only the tested synthetic harness behavior; they do not validate production security, real-shelf recognition, or UNO Q performance."},{"claim":"On development synthetic cases, the reference substantially outperformed the naive raw-catalogue baseline, but was not fully compliant.","evidence":"Implemented and tested → Validation table, `local_baselines.py`: reference 300/336 complete, 12 policy violations, 0 crashes; naive 44/336 complete, 268 policy violations, 0 crashes.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether gateway policy enforcement and agent controls are worth demonstrating relative to a naive baseline.","caveat":"These are development-only aggregates across different C/G policies, not held-out results, model results, production-gateway bypass tests, or real-world performance."},{"claim":"The smoke batch proved durable execution of a nine-episode pipeline, not model competence.","evidence":"Implemented and tested → Validation table, tiny detached cloud batch: 9 durable episodes, reference 3/3, naive 0/3, Kimi 1/3, no episode infrastructure failures; Cloud apps and durable paths → final three Kimi cases: date_only passed, stale_quote and malformed_quantity failed.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the cloud harness can be resumed and whether Kimi is ready for the full synthetic run.","caveat":"Only three Kimi development cases ran, with two policy failures; smoke baseline files also predate the final signed-policy-snapshot implementation."},{"claim":"No full-run model benchmark result exists at the handoff snapshot.","evidence":"Full-run handoff snapshot → 239 baseline episodes confirmed; baseline sweep still running; full-run model episodes have not started; Kimi execution validated only by the separate smoke batch.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the team may report held-out, variance, latency, token, or Kimi-versus-DeepSeek conclusions.","caveat":"The application was still running, so later durable results may exist, but none are evidenced in this handoff."},{"claim":"The reference has a reproducible synthetic product-rule-change safety defect.","evidence":"Usage and limitations → Two reference gaps, item 1 Safety: cached product properties can permit an order after `lactose_free` removal; 12 dev configurations violate the current-product rule; `test_reference_product_change_regression` reproduces current behavior.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether integration must repair quote rechecking before an end-to-end approval/order demonstration or production claim.","caveat":"The regression test asserts the defect rather than a fix, and the 12 cases are synthetic development evidence."},{"claim":"The reference also misses required escalation when every safe product is unavailable.","evidence":"Usage and limitations → Two reference gaps, item 2 Completion: backend records `blocked` instead of requesting Head chef intervention; 24 dev configurations fail the escalation contract; no unsafe order.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether exception handling and human-approval behavior need remediation before judging.","caveat":"This establishes a synthetic contract failure, not the frequency or consequences of the defect in real operations."},{"claim":"DeepSeek comparison is blocked, while Kimi has only minimal execution evidence.","evidence":"Cloud apps and durable paths → DeepSeek probe returned 403 and Kimi returned 200; Full-run handoff snapshot → DeepSeek remains HTTP 403 pending subscription availability.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether to simplify the presentation to one model and avoid cross-model claims.","caveat":"A Kimi HTTP 200 probe and three smoke episodes do not establish reliability at full-run scale."},{"claim":"Important production and shelf boundaries remain untested.","evidence":"Usage and limitations → C3 uses an unreachable camera window of 1e12 s; refill covers only immediate full/empty; approval scenarios do not test HTTP PIN authentication; signed temporary configurations do not test production signing endpoints; harness tests compliance, not production-gateway bypass.","evidence_class":"code-claim","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Which autonomy, security, robustness, and production-readiness claims are safe to make in the demo.","caveat":"These are explicit scope limitations, so results cannot be extrapolated to camera health, authentication, signing, bypass resistance, or broader refill behavior."},{"claim":"Cost evidence is partial and cannot support a settled benchmark-cost claim.","evidence":"Usage and limitations → smoke app costs total $0.00418181 at that snapshot; workspace monthly summary includes other writers; Full-run handoff snapshot → latest per-app rows and $3.29692007 workspace summary are delayed metered snapshots, not settled bills; absent rows mean unreported usage.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether to add a monetary cap and how to report hackathon infrastructure cost.","caveat":"One successful probe's usage was lost, billing is delayed and workspace-wide, no token-dollar rate is assumed, and the driver has no monetary cap."},{"claim":"There is no real-shelf accuracy or UNO Q performance evidence.","evidence":"Implemented and tested → `summarize.py`: No real-shelf table has data; Usage and limitations → data and results are synthetic, not real-shelf accuracy evidence; Full-run handoff snapshot → All work is synthetic; no real-shelf accuracy claim.","evidence_class":"synthetic","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether to claim product recognition, continuous shelf observation, replenishment performance, or kitchen-box feasibility.","caveat":"Nothing here validates the team's actual products, camera images, recognition accuracy, latency on the UNO Q, or the pending simulated replenishment proposal."},{"claim":"Round 3 integration is not complete because its changes are uncommitted.","evidence":"Commits → Round 3 changes are uncommitted; Commit blocked by filesystem sandbox → Git index.lock `Operation not permitted`, no round 3 commit created, `round3.patch` supplied.","evidence_class":"measured-infrastructure","supported":"yes","decision_informed":"Whether the coordinator can reproduce the run from the branch or must first inspect, stage, and commit the owned paths.","caveat":"Cloud results may be durable, but source provenance and code-hash interpretation still require integration verification."}],"unsupported_or_overstated":["Any claim of held-out model performance, Kimi reliability, Kimi-versus-DeepSeek superiority, or measured repeat variance: full-run model episodes had not started, DeepSeek returned 403, and Kimi smoke performance was 1/3.","“Kimi's model execution was validated” is supportable only as a narrow pipeline-execution statement; it would be overstated as validation of accuracy, policy compliance, robustness, or production readiness.","“No external blockers for Kimi” should not be read as proof of full-scale completion: the full model phase had not started, there is no monetary cap, and only a tiny smoke run exercised Kimi.","Any claim that the benchmark validates the production gateway's resistance to bypass, HTTP PIN authentication, production signing endpoints, or real approval security exceeds the stated harness scope.","Any claim of real-shelf product recognition, UNO Q latency/accuracy, continuous observation, scheduled replenishment, or end-to-end kitchen-box performance is unsupported; all benchmark data are synthetic and no real-shelf table has data.","Any settled total-cost figure, zero-cost interpretation of an absent billing row, or attribution of workspace monthly spend to this benchmark would exceed the delayed and partial billing evidence.","Any claim that round 3 is committed or directly reproducible from the named branch is contradicted by the explicit index-lock failure and uncommitted source state.","Treating the reference's 300/336 development completion as a clean control result would overstate it: the handoff separately documents 12 unsafe product-rule-change configurations and 24 failed escalation configurations."],"repetitive_or_low_value":["Repeat listings of the same Modal app IDs, function-call IDs, dashboard links, and resume status in multiple sections; keep one operational table in an appendix.","The several delayed workspace and per-app billing snapshots; a team summary needs only the partial-cost caveat and a pointer to raw billing evidence.","Repeated statements that results are synthetic and not real-shelf evidence; retain one prominent scope limitation.","Detailed smoke-attempt failure chronology and exact timestamps once the negative findings and fixes are summarized.","Full CLI resume/download instructions, directory-creation workaround, and Git commit command in the team summary; keep them in the operator handoff.","Token arithmetic and the 116-token probe breakdown unless preparing a cost appendix; retain the 19,672 recorded tokens plus one unaccounted probe.","Restatements that no production, sponsor, Valio API, external-order, push, or merge action occurred; consolidate into a single scope note if needed."],"negative_results":["The naive development baseline completed only 44/336 cases and incurred 268 policy violations, showing that raw catalogue access is not an adequate controlled-ordering baseline.","The reference still had 12 development configurations that ordered contrary to a current product rule because quote rechecking used cached product properties.","The reference failed the required Head chef escalation in 24 development configurations when all safe products were unavailable, although it made no unsafe order there.","Kimi passed only 1 of 3 smoke episodes; stale_quote and malformed_quantity produced policy violations.","DeepSeek remained unavailable with HTTP 403, preventing a cross-model comparison.","The first two smoke attempts failed before useful completion—one on container path calculation and one on a duplicate `usage` keyword—before the resume completed.","One successful probe's token usage was lost before persistence, so recorded smoke usage is incomplete.","The full run had produced only baseline episodes at handoff; no full-run model episodes had started.","Round 3 could not be committed because the filesystem sandbox denied Git index-lock creation.","C3 camera behavior, broader refill health/timeout boundaries, HTTP PIN authentication, production signing endpoints, production-gateway bypass, and all real-shelf recognition remain unvalidated."],"open_question_worth_a_run":["Let the single existing full Modal app finish without launching a duplicate, download `/runs/r3-full`, and run `summarize.py` with separate dev/held-out, C/G, actor, and family tables. Report completion, violations, unnecessary refusals, crashes, infrastructure failures, latency, tokens, and disagreement-triggered repeat variance; add DeepSeek only if a batch-start probe returns HTTP 200. This would resolve whether the smoke findings generalize across the frozen synthetic benchmark.","Capture a labeled validation set of the team's actual shelf products using the intended UNO Q camera, lighting, distances, occlusion, empty-shelf, and packaging-variant conditions, then run the kitchen client through the real gateway with ordering still approval-gated. Measure per-product recognition/confusion, empty/full detection, end-to-end latency and failures on the UNO Q, and audit/approval correctness; do not enable scheduled replenishment until the team separately approves it. This would test the currently unsupported real-shelf and hardware claims."]}
